title: One Day Expert Colloquium on CRISPR Revolution & Seaweed for Future Foods
summary: Organized by the Department of Biology with Presidential Address by Vice-Chancellor Dr. N. Panchanatham and Keynote by Dr. P. Anantharaman.
content: The Department of Biology hosted a landmark colloquium focused on CRISPR genome editing, eco-friendly entrepreneurship, and marine seaweed applications in modern medicine.

title: TRIVISTA '26 National Tech Symposium Launched
summary: Jointly organized by Department of Computer Science & Applications and Centre for AI & Data Sciences.
content: The Vice-Chancellor inaugurates TRIVISTA '26 bringing tech talent across South India to compete in AI modeling, coding hackathons, and research paper presentations.

title: MoU Signed with Algorian Software Solutions
summary: Strategic partnership between Algorian Software Solutions, Dindigul and Department of Rural Industries & Management.
content: The MoU aims to facilitate industrial internships, student placements, and collaborative research in rural enterprise digitalization.

title: 38th Convocation Ceremony Celebrated at GRI Campus
summary: Honoris Causa presented to Sri VVS Laxman, former Indian Cricketer, alongside graduation degrees to over 1200 scholars.
content: Chancellor Dr. KM. Annamalai delivered the Convocation Address, highlighting the university's pioneer role in rural higher education and Gandhian values.
